acquisition: The Q-Enactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher Scientific) LC-MS was run in DDA mode
DDA was performed with following settings: mz range, 100–1700 mz
labeling: stable isotope-labeled synthetic H3.3K27M peptides... incorporating a heavy Proline at P5 (13C5, 15N1)
quantification: subsequently interrogated for specific peptides using targeted LC-MRM approaches
spiked with an internal heavy peptide standard that co-elutes with any endogenous “light” peptide
enrichment: solubilized pHLA complexes were captured using BB7.2 followed by W6/32 resin
HLA class I peptides were pulled down using HLA specific antibodies such as anti HLA A2 (BB7.2), anti HLA A3 (GAPA3) and pan class I antibody (W6/32)
workflow_hints: Despite using sensitive immunopeptidomics, we could not detect the H3.3K27M26–35-HLA-A∗02:01 peptide
enzyme used was set to none with following variable modifications: oxidation at Met, deamidation at Asp and Gln

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a combination of DDA for discovery and MRM for targeted quantification of MHC-bound peptides (immunopeptidomics). No enzymatic digestion was used (enzyme set to none) as the targets are naturally processed peptides.

organism: searching against the human proteome (Uniprot 15/06/2017; 20,182 entries)
cell_lines: HEK293T H3.3 WT and HEK293T H3.3K27M-mutant cells
H3.3K27M transfected C1R HLA-A∗02:01 and C1R HLA-A∗03:01 cells
four DIPG cell lines (SU DIPG 27, SU DIPG 35, SU DIPG 38, and SU DIPG 43)
scope: solubilized material passed through a PAS pre-column, followed by serial affinity capture columns
lysate was first passed through a BB7.2 column (to pull down HLA-A∗02:01 complexes) followed by a W6/32 column
solubilized pHLA complexes were captured using BB7.2 followed by W6/32 resin
Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis focused exclusively on the immunopeptidome, specifically capturing HLA class I complexes via immunoaffinity purification (BB7.2, GAPA3, and W6/32 antibodies) before LC-MS/MS analysis.
